source.author: verg
source.text: Talibus Ilioneus; cuncti simul ore fremebant Dardanidae.
source.text_original: Talibus Ilioneus; cuncti simul ore fremebant / Dardanidae.
source.text_english: With words like these Ilioneus spoke; all the sons of Dardanus together murmured assent.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at cuncti fremere intus et aequora venti poscere.
reuse.text_original: at cuncti fremere intus et aequora venti / poscere.
reuse.text_english: But all within were roaring and demanding the seas for the winds.
